messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] vmmin error when analyzing capture recapture data
parts:
"intervalMat" should have 2 rows instead of 31. 


On Mon, Nov 5, 2012 at 11:31 AM, Dan Bachen <daniel...@gmail.com> wrote:
vmmin error when analyzing capture recapture data




Hi All,
I am trying to analyze a capture-recapture data set using unmarked as described in "Modeling variation in abundance using capture-recapture data" by Chandler. Creating the unmarked frame for the analysis seems straightforward but when I  try to fit a model (M0 etc) I get the error message "Error in optim(starts, nll, method = method, hessian = se, ...) :   initial value in 'vmmin' is not finite".  I am just interested in getting abundance and capture probability by site, right now I am not going to worry about site specific covariates like aspect and vegetation. This is driving me crazy trying to get the analysis to work so if anyone has any insight into how to correct this problem I would greatly appreciate it. Below is my code and attached is my data set in csv format and r script.
Thanks,
Dan
MS Student 
Department of Ecology
Montana State University

#Read Data in
# 2 sites, trapped 5 nights w/ unique marks on mice

crPiFun<-function(p){

cbind("10000" = p1 * (1-p2) * (1-p3) * (1-p4) * (1-p5),
"01000" = (1-p1) * p2 * (1-p3) *(1-p4) *(1-p5),
"00100" = (1-p1) * (1-p2) * (p3) * (1-p4) * (1-p5),
"00010" = (1-p1) * (1-p2) * (1-p3) * p4 * (1-p5),
"00001" = (1-p1) * (1-p2) * (1-p3) * (1-p4)* p5,
"11000" = p1 * p2 * (1-p3) * (1-p4) * (1-p5),

"00110" = (1-p1) * (1-p2) * p3 * p4 * (1-p5),
"00011" = (1-p1) * (1-p2) * (1-p3) * p4 * p5,
"10100" = p1 * (1-p2) * p3 * (1-p4) * (1-p5),
"01010" = (1-p1) * p2 * (1-p3) * p4 * (1-p5),
"00101" = (1-p1) * (1-p2) * p3 * (1-p4) * p5,
"10010" =  p1 * (1-p2) * (1-p3) * p4 * (1-p5),
"01001" = (1-p1) * p2 * (1-p3) * (1-p4) * p5,
"10001" =  p1 * (1-p2) * (1-p3) * (1-p4) * p5,
"11100" = p1 * p2 * p3 * (1-p4) * (1-p5),
"01110" = (1-p1) * p2 * p3 * p4 * (1-p5),
"00111" = (1-p1) * (1-p2) * p3 * p4 * p5,
"11010" = p1 * p2 * (1-p3) * p4 * (1-p5),
"01101" = (1-p1) * p2 * p3 * (1-p4) * p5,
"10110" = p1 * (1-p2) * p3 * p4 * (1-p5),
"01011" = (1-p1) * p2 * (1-p3) * p4 * p5,

"10111" = p1 * (1-p2)* p3 * p4 * p5,

}

intervalMat <- matrix(c('1','2','3','4','5'),31, 5, byrow=TRUE)
###############################

###

##########################
#unmarked frame
class(data.H1) <- "matrix"
umf.cr1 <- unmarkedFrameMPois(y=data.H1,
siteCovs= NULL,
obsCovs=list(interval=intervalMat),
